description: This file contains unit tests for the WakeWordGate component of the SwabbleKit framework, focusing on matching wake word triggers, handling command extraction, multi-word triggers, and range index processing.

classes.name: WakeWordGateTests
classes.description: A test suite that verifies the behavior of the WakeWordGate, including trigger matching, gap handling, multi-word triggers, and range index processing.

methods.name: matchRequiresGapAfterTrigger
methods.description: Tests that the WakeWordGate correctly requires a minimum gap after the wake word trigger before recognizing subsequent commands.

methods.name: matchAllowsGapAndExtractsCommand
methods.description: Tests that the WakeWordGate allows a gap after the trigger and correctly extracts the command text.

methods.name: matchHandlesMultiWordTriggers
methods.description: Verifies that multi-word triggers are handled correctly by the WakeWordGate.

methods.name: commandTextHandlesForeignRangeIndices
methods.description: Ensures that command text extraction correctly handles segments with ranges from foreign strings.
